The Frappe app frappe-nix's app standards self-tests run against
(`docs/app-standards/spec.md` §1.3). It is not published anywhere. Its
publisher, e-mail and URLs are fictitious (`Example Org`, `example.org`).

It has one of each thing the platform checks: a DocType, a tested whitelisted
function and a deliberately untested one (exempted in `[[tool.frappe-nix.untested]]`),
`doc_events` and `extend_doctype_class` on ToDo, a scheduler job, an
`after_request` hook, a demo hook, a marketplace listing, an icon pair and a
screenshot spec. The files `frappe-nix sync` manages are committed by the sync
engine; everything else here is hand-written.
